analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, registering 35% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA of ₹89 crore. Despite early quarter headwinds from supply chain disruptions, geopolitical issues in West Asia, and raw material cost inflation, monsoon activity revived significantly in early July to boost agricultural sentiment. Management expressed confidence in achieving an additional 30%-35% turnover growth over last year and quarterly revenues exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27. The company also executed a 5-for-1 stock split during the period and expanded its complex fertilizer product portfolio. Krishana Phoschem Limited presented its Q1 FY27 financial results, reporting a 34.58% YoY increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY growth in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over the previous year across the remaining quarters.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver a quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key financial parameters during FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a revenue increase of around Rs. 500 crore from its expanded capacity in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27, generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, reducing the all-India rainfall deficit to approximately 24% by the first week of July.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon conditions, higher crop MSPs, and government NBS support are expected to support fertilizer demand through the rest of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: A favorable monsoon outlook and stable agricultural environment provide a constructive demand environment for fertilizers.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or publicly disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Utilization of the NPK capacity commissioned during the previous quarter is expected to steadily ramp up over coming quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: The NPK capacity commission during the previous quarter is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over the coming quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP (165,000 MTPA) and Sulphuric Acid (99,000 MTPA) are now contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company increased its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, raising total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem enhanced its backward integration by establishing a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion was funded using a combination of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA grew 36% year-on-year to ₹89 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stands at roughly 7%–8% for trading operations and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of input cost increases through higher subsidy support and revised selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation rose from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore and finance costs grew from ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore following capacity commissioning.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached Rs. 90 crore, up 59% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year FY26 EBITDA stood at Rs. 298 crore, reflecting a 62% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates margin pressure in FY27 as full EBITDA levels of FY26 may not be completely sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem achieved 43% capacity utilization in NPK-DAP and 121% in SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total NPK-DAP capacity reached 495,000 MT following the addition of 165,000 MT to the existing 330,000 MT capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT during Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons while manufacturing volumes reached 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a rock phosphate beneficiation capacity of 200,000 tons operating at 50% to 75% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL upgraded the company's credit rating to A+ (Stable).
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stood at nearly Rs. 400 crore while other receivables ranged between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective borrowing interest cost ranges from 6% to 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The phosphatic supplier industry faced global supply chain disruptions, high input costs, and geopolitical tensions in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices surged from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer industry's reliance on imports for about 90% of key intermediates directly impacts cost structures during global input price swings.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Company profitability is expected to decrease slightly in FY27 as cost increases are partially absorbed.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve over ₹500 crore in quarterly turnover for each of the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to deliver an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over last year across the remaining quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: The 70,000 MTPA third-party green ammonia capacity arrangement is scheduled to begin in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to delivering growth exceeding 40% across key financial parameters in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects benefits from newly added operational capacities to meaningfully reflect in financials from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects supply under its 10-year Green Ammonia contract to commence after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
